allow: PowerShell($os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; "{0:N1} GB free of {1:N1} GB" -f \($os.FreePhysicalMemory/1MB\), \($os.TotalVisibleMemorySize/1MB\); Get-Process qemu-system-x86_64 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, @{n='CPU_s';e={[int]$_.CPU}}, @{n='WS_GB';e={[math]::Round\($_.WorkingSet64/1GB,1\)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String)

PowerShell(Get-Process qemu-system-x86_64 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id,@{n='CPU_s';e={[int]$_.CPU}},@{n='WS_GB';e={[math]::Round\($_.WorkingSet64/1GB,1\)}},@{n='Age_min';e={[int]\(\(Get-Date\)-$_.StartTime\).TotalMinutes}} | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String; $os=Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; "free RAM {0:N1} GB" -f \($os.FreePhysicalMemory/1MB\))

PowerShell(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'shoot_avd|shot_one|shot_all' } | Select-Object ProcessId, @{n='Cmd';e={$_.CommandLine.Substring\(0,[Math]::Min\(140,$_.CommandLine.Length\)\)}} | Format-List | Out-String)
